units.note: No Democrat on ballot (Byron Mallott joined Walker's 'unity' ticket as LG); independent Bill Walker -> D-side.
Dannel Malloy: fusion lines Democratic Party (United States) + Working Families Party summed. Thomas C. Foley: fusion lines Republican Party (United States) + Independent Party of Connecticut summed.

Andrew Cuomo: fusion lines Democratic Party (United States) + Working Families Party + Independence Party of New York + Women's Equality Party (New York) summed. Rob Astorino: fusion lines Republican Party (United States) + Conservative Party of New York State + Stop Common Core Party summed.
No candidate won a majority (Shumlin 46.4%); the Vermont General Assembly elected Peter Shumlin (D) in January 2015.
R-side sums Scott Walker (Republican Party (United States)) 1,259,706 + Steve R. Evans (Republican Party (United States)) 9 + Susan P. Resch (Republican Party (United States)) 8.
